dataset.title: DataSet API was removed
dataset.fix: Rewrite batch jobs on the DataStream API in BATCH mode, or on Table API/SQL.

scala.title: Scala DataStream and DataSet APIs were removed
scala.fix: Move the job to the Java DataStream API (it can still be called from Scala code).

source-function.title: SourceFunction was removed
source-function.fix: Use a FLIP-27 Source (org.apache.flink.api.connector.source.Source), e.g. KafkaSource or DataGeneratorSource.

sink-function.title: SinkFunction was removed
sink-function.fix: Use a Sink V2 (org.apache.flink.api.connector.sink2.Sink), e.g. KafkaSink or FileSink.

sink-v1.title: Sink V1 / old Sink V2 mix-ins were removed
sink-v1.fix: Implement the current Sink V2 interfaces (SupportsWriterState, SupportsCommitter).

table-source-sink.title: Legacy TableSource/TableSink stack was removed
table-source-sink.fix: Implement DynamicTableSource / DynamicTableSink with a DynamicTableFactory.

table-schema.title: TableSchema, TableColumn and Types were removed

restart-strategy.title: RestartStrategies API was removed
restart-strategy.fix: Set restart-strategy.type and its options on a Configuration (RestartStrategyOptions).

state-backend.title: Old state backend classes were removed
state-backend.fix: Use HashMapStateBackend or EmbeddedRocksDBStateBackend, or set state.backend.type via config.

state-processor.title: DataSet-based State Processor API classes were removed

other.title: Class was removed in Flink 2.0
other.fix: See the Flink 2.0 release notes for the replacement.

member.title: Method, field or constructor was removed in Flink 2.0
member.fix: See the Flink 2.0 release notes for the replacement; most config setters moved to Configuration/ConfigOption.

config.title: Configuration option was removed in Flink 2.0
config.fix: Delete it or use its replacement option (see the Flink 2.0 configuration docs).
